mechanics.title: Gulping air
mechanics.description: Right-click an empty bottle underwater to restore air (default 150 of 300). This creates a water bottle.

mechanics.title: Evaporation
mechanics.description: Holding a fire-type item (campfire, fire charge, lava bucket, magma block) in the offhand evaporates the water bottle and returns an empty bottle, with a 50% chance (default) that the bottle breaks.

mechanics.title: No underwater drinking
mechanics.description: By default water bottles cannot be drunk underwater, so they do not give infinite oxygen.

commands_and_keybinds: Right-click an empty glass bottle while underwater
editor_notes: Defaults per mod page; no pack override found. Category could also be Transport & Movement.
name: Bottled Air
summary: Right-click an empty glass bottle while underwater (air bar visible) to breathe in extra air. Each bottle refills half the air bar by default.
